hotels.title: Tulum Beachfront Private Pool Oasis with Daily Breakfast & Nightly Cocktails
hotels.description: Nestled along a 900-metre stretch of Tulum's pristine Caribbean coastline, Papaya Playa Project offers a unique blend of rustic charm and eco-conscious design. This beachfront retreat features Mayan inspired suites and cabanas crafted from local materials, providing a harmonious connection with the surrounding jungle and sea. The resort is also close to Jaguar Park, a protected natural area where visitors can explore Tulum’s tropical landscapes and cultural heritage. The resort's beachfront restaurant serves dishes inspired by traditional Mayan and Mexican cuisines, prepared with organic, locally sourced ingredients. Guests can enjoy a wellness program immersion, or participate in yoga classes and Mayan holistic healing rituals at the onsite spa. Located on the edge of Tulum's hotel zone, Papaya Playa Project is just a short drive from downtown Tulum and the Tulum Archaeological Site. The resort's commitment to sustainability and its vibrant community atmosphere make it an ideal destination for those seeking a unique and immersive experience in Tulum.
